verdict.rationale: Gemini's Deep Research feature explicitly grounds answers in real-time Google Search results and lets users add other sources (Gmail, Drive, uploaded files), which supports current-web-grounded research (gemini-docs-7, gemini-docs-47, gemini-docs-29). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents an inline citation/footnote mechanism linking specific claims back to source URLs, so the 'citations back to the sources' half of the story is only implied, not confirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline source citations/footnotes in Deep Research or standard chat answers, independent hands-on confirmation of citation accuracy.
